title: Advancements in Remote Sensing for Agriculture Mapping

subtasks.task_text: Explain the importance of remote sensing in agriculture.
subtasks.text: Describe how remote sensing has become crucial for understanding and managing agricultural practices.

subtasks.task_text: Review current state-of-the-art techniques in remote sensing for agriculture.
subtasks.text: Detail the focus of current studies on crop succession, cropping patterns, and techniques.

subtasks.task_text: Highlight the limitations of current research in remote sensing.
subtasks.text: Note that most studies rely on local ground data and few incorporate multiple sensors.

subtasks.task_text: Discuss future research directions for remote sensing in agriculture.
subtasks.text: Mention the need for developing more robust mapping methods using satellite imagery.
